uiLanguage.name: Module language
uiLanguage.hint: Language of Deep Tables on this device. "Like Foundry" follows Foundry's language.

theme.name: Look
theme.hint: Signature shows the windows on warm paper, Foundry keeps them dark like the rest of Foundry.

showChances.name: Show chances in tables
showChances.hint: Shows the chance of every row next to its range when you look at a table.

maxDepth.name: Depth of tables inside tables
maxDepth.hint: How many levels of tables inside tables are followed. Circles are always stopped.

autoActions.name: Results may act on their own
autoActions.hint: Actions of results that are set to run when the card is shown. Turn this off and every action waits for its button.

triggerTables.name: Roll tables of Roll Triggers with Deep Tables
triggerTables.hint: A trigger that rolls a table, for example a natural 20 on the critical hit table, shows the Deep Tables card with quantities, nested tables and actions.

Deep.title: Deep roll: {name}
Deep.drawsHint: How many times the table is drawn. A number or a formula like 1d4+1.
Deep.noOther: No other result is left for this line.
Deep.invalidDraws: The number of draws could not be rolled, one draw is used.
Deep.invalidQuantity: Quantity could not be rolled, 1 is used

Problem.cycle: Stopped at a circle: {table} leads back to itself.
Problem.depth: {table} is nested too deep and was left out.
Problem.impossible: {table} has no result for its formula.
Problem.invalid: The formula of {table} cannot be rolled.
Problem.ranOut: {table} ran out before all draws were made.

Draw.emptyAsk: All results of {name} are drawn. Bring them all back?

Give.title: Give to character
Give.nothing: There are no items or coins to give.
Give.noActors: There are no actors to give to.
Give.noPurse: This game system has no purse the module can fill. Coins stay as text.
Give.coinsSkipped: These coins have no place in the purse: {coins}

Pile.pick: Click on the map where the pile goes. Escape cancels.
Pile.failed: The loot pile could not be created.

Error.action: That did not work. Details are in the console.

Sheet.drawsHint: How often the table is drawn at once, a number or a formula like 1d4+1. Empty means once.
Sheet.distinctHint: A result comes up only once in one roll.
Sheet.modeHint: Who sees the result card. "Like in Foundry" follows the chat setting of whoever rolls.
Sheet.quantityHint: How many: an item comes as many times, a table is drawn that often, a text repeats. A number or a formula like 2d4+1.
Sheet.memoryHint: Results that came up are not drawn again until you reset the table, even after a restart. Only rolls of Deep Tables count.
Sheet.memoryHintNoReplacement: This table draws without replacement, so Foundry already marks what came up. Remembering adds nothing here, the counter and the reset work anyway.
Sheet.playersHint: The table shows up in the list of tables players can roll, with the visibility set above. The GM rolls it for them, so players need no permission on the table.

Import.buttonHint: Paste a list and make a roll table from it
Import.title: Table from text
Import.hint: Ranges (1-4 Goblin), numbers (5: Wolf), weights (Goblin | 3) or one entry per line. A first line like d20 Encounters gives the name and the formula.
Import.name: Name
Import.nothing: Nothing recognized yet. Paste a list above.

problem.beyond: Some rows are above the highest roll of {formula}.
problem.formula: The formula {formula} does not match the {total} weights, the formula was changed to fit.
problem.overlaps: Rolls in more than one row: {list}
problem.backwards: The range {from} to {to} was turned around.

Journal.tooltip: Draw from the table. Shift opens the deep roll.

SELFTEST.Title: Self test
SELFTEST.Hint: Checks after an update that everything the module relies on is there.
SELFTEST.NewVersions: Foundry is newer than the verified version ({versions}). Run the self test if something looks wrong.
SELFTEST.Tables: Foundry's roll tables work differently than expected.
SELFTEST.Sheet: Foundry's roll table sheet is missing.
SELFTEST.Chat: Foundry's chat or its message setting is missing.
SELFTEST.Templates: A window template of the module could not be loaded.
SELFTEST.Coins: The coins of the game system could not be read.
SELFTEST.Piles: The module for loot piles does not offer what this module needs.
SELFTEST.Ledger: The Loot Ledger does not offer what the module needs.
SELFTEST.Memory: The memory of tables does not work as expected.
SELFTEST.Actions: The actions of results do not work as expected.
SELFTEST.Players: The list of tables for players or the module socket is missing.
SELFTEST.Placing: Foundry's tokens, statuses or audio work differently than expected.
SELFTEST.Encounters: Saved Encounters does not offer what the module needs.

DEBUG.Title: Debug file
DEBUG.Hint: Saves one file for bug reports about all of Sephral’s modules in this world: versions, settings and what the modules recorded, such as the latest chat messages they read. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
DEBUG.Saved: Debug file {file} saved. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.

Memory.off: The table does not remember what was drawn.

Action.label: Action
Action.title: Action: {name}
Action.addHint: Let this result do something when it comes up: place tokens, play a sound, show a journal and more.
Action.incomplete: The action does not know what to work with yet.
Action.undoHint: Remove what this action placed or applied
Action.auto: Run on its own when the card is shown
Action.autoHint: Only the GM runs actions. The setting for results acting on their own in the module settings can switch this off for all.
Action.linkedHint: This result links to a document, an empty field below uses that document.
Action.combat: Start a fight with the placed tokens
Action.actorPlaceholder: Name or UUID, drop an actor here
Action.noEncounters: Saved Encounters is needed to place a saved encounter.
Action.noEncounter: The saved encounter was not found.
Action.noSound: The playlist or sound was not found.
Action.gone: The result no longer has this action.

hint.none: Choose what this result does when it comes up.
hint.encounter: Opens the placing of Saved Encounters with its ghost preview. A quantity on the result places the group that many times.
hint.tokens: You click a spot on the map and the tokens stand around it. The number can be a formula like 1d4+1, empty uses the quantity of the result.
hint.sound: Plays a sound or a playlist for everyone, or an audio file you pick.
hint.journal: Shows a journal to the players or only opens it for you. A page is opened at its place for you and shown as its journal to the players.
hint.effect: Gives a status or effect to the tokens you have selected or targeted when you click.
hint.macro: Runs a macro of the world. It gets the table, the result and the quantity as the first argument.

Players.title: Tables to roll
Players.none: The GM has not released any table for you yet.
Players.noGM: No GM is online to roll for you.

status.empty: Nothing is left on this table.
status.denied: You may not roll this table.
